biography: Max Coates, a name synonymous with relentless aggression on the track, hails from the unassuming town of Boroughbridge, North Yorkshire. His motorsport journey began, not in a karting arena like so many others, but behind the wheel of his father's beat-up Ford Fiesta, tearing around local farms on weekends. This unorthodox training honed his car control and fearlessness, qualities that would later define his racing style. Coates burst onto the Ginetta scene in 2010, immediately making a splash with a string of podium finishes that defied his rookie status. A defining moment came in 2015 at Brands Hatch, where he wrestled his Ginetta G55 to victory in a rain-soaked race, showcasing his mastery of treacherous conditions. Despite several near-misses and championship challenges, Coates has yet to capture a major title, fueling his burning desire to prove himself at the highest level. Now 37, he remains a formidable presence in the Ginetta paddock, a veteran racer still hungry for glory.
drivingStyle: Coates is known for his aggressive, no-holds-barred driving style. He attacks corners with a late-braking technique, often pushing the limits of grip and flirting with disaster. Tire management is not his forte; Coates prefers to extract maximum performance early in a stint, sacrificing longevity for immediate pace. While this approach can lead to spectacular overtakes and blistering lap times, it also makes him prone to late-race fade and costly mistakes under pressure.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Alvarez
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at Oulton Park in 2017, where Alvarez accused Coates of intentionally taking him out of the race.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Rossi
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle for the lead in the 2021 Ginetta GT4 SuperCup season finale, with Rossi ultimately prevailing, leaving Coates feeling robbed of a championship victory.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A clash of cultures and driving philosophies, with Tanaka's smooth, precise style often clashing with Coates's more visceral approach, leading to several heated exchanges both on and off the track.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, threadbare and faded, for every race.
Refuses to eat bananas on race weekends, believing they bring bad luck.
Listens to heavy metal music at ear-splitting volume in the minutes before getting into the car to get himself 'pumped up'.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I'm here to win, no matter what it takes."
careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta GT4 SuperCup race at Brands Hatch in 2015 in torrential rain, demonstrating exceptional car control and tactical awareness.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2018 Ginetta GT4 SuperCup championship decider at Donington Park, costing him the title.
